summary: Max Conway (23) took a 30-foot leader fall on Mudflap Girl, Grizzly Creek Wall, when protection failed; knocked unconscious ~2 minutes, sustained multiple pelvic fractures (requiring surgery) and two rib fractures; partner triggered inReach SOS and an Army National Guard helicopter evacuated him ~4.5 hours later.
location: Mudflap Girl, Grizzly Creek Wall, Glenwood Canyon
notes: ANAC 2024 edition (Pub 2024); incident date Nov 11 per article. City of Glenwood Springs press release (11/11/2023): GSAR + Mountain Rescue Aspen + Vail Mountain Rescue + Army Guard HAATS; single-rescuer lowered from hovering helo, climber and partner hoisted out and flown to Glenwood Springs Airport, then ambulance to Valley View Hospital; ~4.5-hr op, 36 rescuers. | Alpine 2023-113: assist to Garfield County SAR with a State SAR Coordinator, dispatched 15:28. RUN 858 MERGE: MRA FB mission post (posted 2023-11-14) corroborates the HAATS hoist rescue — MRA mutual aid to Glenwood Springs Fire, subject hoisted near cliff face ~1:30 PM 2023-11-11, all safe.
